_comment: The bridge between a physical OSM footprint and an Energy IQ building.
It is a separate file from the geometry on purpose. Re-running
scripts/build_campus_geojson.py overwrites a campus's geometry wholesale;
this file is never touched by that script, so the curated identity survives
an OSM refresh. The reverse also holds: an association may be corrected
`osm_type` + `osm_id` identify the map feature. `energy_iq_building_id` is a
`buildings.id`. The OSM name is NEVER the key — it is absent on most
footprints, and where present it is a local nickname rather than the
institutional name (this is why the pair below reads 'Servicios
Telemáticos' in OSM and 'DIGESET' in the organisational chart).
`confidence` records how the association was made, because a footprint is
matched by a human reading a map, not by a join:
surveyed  — someone confirmed the panel is inside this outline
inferred  — the building's organisational unit names this dependency
An id that no longer exists in either OSM or `buildings` is reported by the
API as an orphan rather than silently dropped. See docs/CampusMap.md.

associations.note: Buildings 9 and 10 both sit under the Servicios Telemáticos / DIGESET dependency (organizational_units 60 and 71), which occupies this footprint. Building 10 carries the active deployment.
Second Energy IQ building in the same physical footprint — a different panel/era, deployment 6, now closed.
